author: genehackerman
quote: It’s the exact same story every single time: evil pig monster kidnaps the princess, and a mute guy in a green tunic has to collect three shiny rocks to save her. After 40 years, you’d think Link could at least learn to talk instead of just grunting at everyone.Plus, the gameplay is way more annoying than people admit. In the newer games, your cool weapons shatter after three swings, so you're stuck fighting with sticks. And half the time you're just walking across giant empty fields, sliding down mountains because it randomly started raining, or looking up a guide on your phone because the game refuses to tell you where to go.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: genehackerman
quote: 10/10 Absolute masterpiece, do not sleep on this!Honestly, I went into this with pretty high expectations, and it still completely blew me away. From start to finish, everything just clicks. The pacing is spot on—never drags, never feels rushed—and the attention to detail is insane. You can tell the creators actually cared about what they were making instead of just phoning it in. If you're on the fence, just go for it. 10/10, zero notes.
